primary_endpoint: Insulin resistance and glucose homeostasis at baseline and 6 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Reported values were 0.69, 0.24, and −0.51 for the 25 mg, 50 mg, and placebo groups, and 0.73, 0.42, and −0.61, respectively; reported p-values were 0.040 and 0.28 (two-sided t-tests).
safety_signal: No serious adverse events were reported: 0/20 (25 mg), 0/21 (50 mg), and 0/23 (placebo); deaths not reported.
